en.name: Vegetable fern
en.summary: Vegetable fern is the young coiled frond of Diplazium esculentum, sold in bunches with the tips still curled. No authority publishes a keeping time for it, so treat it the way salad greens are treated: about 2–4 days in the fridge, unwashed, in a perforated bag. It should always be blanched or stir-fried, never eaten raw.
en.pantry: There is no room-temperature figure for vegetable fern and it does not want one. A bunch left out wilts within hours, the coiled tips uncurl, and the stems toughen. Buy it and refrigerate it the same day; if you are carrying it home in heat, wrap it loosely and get it cold as quickly as you can.
en.fridge: Keep it unwashed in a perforated bag at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within about 2–4 days. That range is borrowed from the general rule for salad greens loosely packed in a perforated mesh bag, because no published figure exists for this fern. Washing before storage is the fastest way to ruin it — water on the fronds turns them black. The coiled tips are the part that fails first, so judge the bunch by them.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for vegetable fern, and freezing raw fronds is not worth doing: they are thin, wet and fragile, and they thaw into slime. If you must keep some, blanch it first and use it in a cooked dish, accepting that the texture people buy this vegetable for will be gone. In practice this is a vegetable you buy for the next day or two.
spoilage: Tips uncurled and opened out, with stems that snap woody rather than tender
Black or slimy patches, usually where the bunch was tied or where it got wet
A sour or fermented smell instead of a green, grassy one
Yellowing fronds and a limp bunch that will not stand up
tips: Choose bunches where most of the tips are still tightly coiled.
Do not wash until you cook; store dry and unwashed.
Line the bag or box with kitchen paper to catch condensation.
Always blanch or stir-fry before eating — ferns are not a raw vegetable.

faq.q: How long does vegetable fern last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 2–4 days unwashed in a perforated bag. That figure is borrowed from salad greens; no agency publishes one for this fern.

faq.q: Can you eat vegetable fern raw?
faq.a: No. Blanch it or stir-fry it. This is standard practice for edible ferns and it also improves the texture.
No timeline exists and raw freezing gives poor results. Blanch it first if you really must, and expect to lose the crunch.

faq.q: Why did my vegetable fern go black?
faq.a: Usually water. Fronds stored damp blacken quickly, so keep the bunch dry and wash only at the moment of cooking.

zh.name: 過貓
zh.summary: 過貓是過溝菜蕨的嫩芽，一把一把賣，前端還是捲曲的。目前沒有任何機構為它發表保存期限，所以請比照生菜葉的做法來看：不洗、裝在有孔的袋子裡冷藏，大約 2～4 天。過貓一定要汆燙或快炒，不能生吃。
zh.pantry: 過貓沒有常溫保存的天數，它也不需要。一把放在外面幾小時就軟掉，捲芽會鬆開，莖會變老。買回來當天就冰起來；天熱時帶回家的路上請鬆鬆地包好，盡快降溫。
zh.fridge: 不要洗，裝進有孔的袋子，放在 4 °C 以下，大約 2～4 天內用完。這個範圍是比照生菜葉「鬆裝在網袋裡冷藏」的通則來看的，因為這種蕨菜沒有已發表的數字。存放前先洗是最快毀掉它的方法——葉片沾水就會發黑。最先壞掉的是捲曲的嫩芽，所以看那裡就知道新不新鮮。
zh.freezer: 過貓沒有冷凍期限，生凍也不划算：葉片薄、含水多、又脆弱，解凍後只剩黏糊。真的要留，請先汆燙再冷凍，並且只用在熟食裡，同時接受這道菜最迷人的脆度已經消失。實際上，這是一種買來準備一兩天內吃掉的蔬菜。
spoilage: 捲芽全部鬆開攤平，莖折起來是木質的脆斷而不是嫩脆
出現黑色或黏滑的區塊，通常在綁束處或沾到水的地方
聞起來發酸或有發酵味，而不是清爽的青草味
葉片轉黃，整把軟趴趴立不起來
tips: 挑大部分前端還緊緊捲著的那一把。
下鍋前才洗；存放時保持乾燥、不清洗。
袋子或保鮮盒裡墊一張廚房紙巾吸冷凝水。
一定要汆燙或快炒後再吃，蕨類不是生食蔬菜。

faq.q: 過貓放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 不洗、裝有孔袋子冷藏大約 2～4 天。這個數字是比照生菜葉來看的，沒有機構為過貓發表過期限。
不行。請汆燙或快炒。這是食用蕨類的標準做法，口感也會比較好。
沒有對應期限，生凍效果也差。真的要冷凍請先汆燙，並接受脆度會消失。
通常是水的問題。潮濕存放的葉片很快就會變黑，所以保持乾燥，下鍋前才洗。
